Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
As Group Product Manager for Data/ML, you'll drive the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Discord's Machine Learning Platform and its applications, particularly to Advertising, while also championing how the broader company uses data to make product decisions. This is a horizontal role reporting to the VP of Product, Business that touches nearly every product team at Discord, as well as core technical teams, so you'll need to be comfortable driving alignment across stakeholders whose goals are sometimes in tension.
What you'll be doing
Guide the product philosophy, vision, and roadmap for Discord's ML Platform and its key use cases (Personalization, Notifications, Safety, Advertising, Recommendations).
Own performance against key data and ML business metrics, and proactively report progress to stakeholders across the company.
Collaborate deeply with Applied ML, ML Platform, and Data Science to build and prioritize the ML roadmap for our Advertising products.
Advise product teams across Discord on how to build and instrument their products with data-first capabilities from the start.
Drive cross-functional execution across all product areas, working with engineers/MLEs, security, legal, and policy partners as needed.
What you should have
8+ years of combined experience in data science and product management, including direct, hands-on experience as a data scientist or in a similarly quantitative role before moving into product.
3-5+ years of product management experience owning algorithmic, data-driven systems (e.g., bidding, ranking, personalization, and/or recommendations systems), including responsibility for prioritization, trade-offs, and timelines.
Proven ability to analyze and synthesize data directly, not just interpret it secondhand, including comfort with the statistical and quantitative fundamentals behind modern ML systems.
Demonstrated technical proficiency working closely with ML/data engineers, including familiarity with ML fundamentals, enough to cut through the buzz and separate what's practical at scale from what isn't.
Experience operating across international or distributed teams and stakeholders.
Bonus Points
Experience in performance advertising and real-time bidding specifically.
Proficiency in modern BI tooling (Looker, Tableau, or similar).
Passion for games, gaming, or online communities.
Candidates must reside in or be willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area (Alameda, Contra Costa, Marin, Napa, San Francisco, San Mateo, Santa Clara, Solano, and Sonoma counties). Relocation assistance may be available.
For this role, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 3 days a week.
The base salary range for this full-time position is listed below. This position will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance; a 401(k) plan; life and disability insurance; paid time off; and paid parental leave. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits. Applications for this role are accepted on an ongoing basis.

$304,000 — $380,000 USD

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! We're looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Engagement ML team, working as part of the cross-functional Onboarding squad in Discord's Growth organization. You'll design and build 0→1 end-to-end ML solutions that help brand-new users find their place on Discord: the servers, people, and content that turn a first session into a long-term connection to the product. If this excites you, keep reading!

Design, build, and scale the recommendation systems that connect new users to communities and content, from candidate generation and ranking through to online serving.
Solve cold-start personalization for users with little or no history on Discord, turning the limited signals available into recommendations for servers, communities, and content.

Collaborate cross-functionally to shape the Onboarding roadmap, balancing fast learning experiments with the long-term complexity and scalability of the systems behind them

5+ years of experience in Machine Learning, Data Science, or Applied Science, with a track record of shipping recommendation or personalization systems end to end.
Hands-on experience building modern recommendation systems: retrieval and ranking pipelines, embedding-based retrieval (e.g. two-tower models), and deep learning models (e.g. transformers, multi-task learning).
Strong proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
Experience taking ML systems from ideation to production at scale, including feature pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and online experimentation.
Strong product intuition and a passion for building 0→1 ML applications grounded in user feedback and real-world impact.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, able to serve as the ML voice on a cross-functional squad and keep stakeholders aligned on trade-offs, priorities, and progress.
The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments, energized by tackling open-ended, technically challenging problems
Bonus Points If You Have:
Experience with cold-start or new-user personalization, onboarding flows, or preference elicitation.
Built user representation models or applied social-graph signals to recommendation problems.
Worked on growth or engagement problems for consumer products, such as community and content recommendations, user activation, or retention.
Experience with large-scale recommendation systems, data infrastructure, distributed computing, and vector search.

discord-8769799002.text:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
More broadly, Discord is about empowering people to find belonging in all kinds of communities, and those people trust us to keep their communications safe. Our Platform Security Engineering team protects the systems we use to create Discord, making the "secure way" the "easy way."
We're looking for a Senior Engineer to advance this mission through security expertise, software development, and operational excellence, with a particular focus on identity and access management: who and what can access Discord's systems, how they authenticate, and how access stays scoped to what's actually needed. You'll help identify leveraged opportunities to reduce security risk across Engineering, then design and deliver technical solutions: lovable "paved paths" for managing identities and access, shipping code, configuring cloud infrastructure, and operating services.
If you're a security engineer with a deep interest in identity and access management, who's eager to own technically and socially complex projects, and excited to improve security and privacy at Discord, read on!
This position is based in our San Francisco office. For this role, the Hiring Manager would like folks to be in the office 1-2 days a week.
What you'll do
Own software engineering projects end-to-end on a highly autonomous, horizontally integrated team with a lot of leverage. This is a code-forward role!
Define what identity means for autonomous agents and other non-human actors at Discord (how they're provisioned, scoped, authenticated, authorized, and audited). As the role of these actors grows, and create primitives to implement that vision.
Build and evolve Access , Discord's employee authorization platform, to make permissions discoverable, role-based, least privilege, and self-serve; check out our blog post to learn more!
Design and harden our Zero Trust architecture, spanning human and service-to-service auth*n for Discord’s internal tooling.
Automate continuous permission right-sizing in the spirit of least privilege.
Develop and apply secure baselines for cloud identity, and help secure our software supply chain from the dev environment through CI/CD and into production.
Consult on risk assessments, architectural designs, threat models, code reviews, and more, pragmatically balancing security with other business considerations.
Example projects
Integrate service-to-service and agent-to-service authentication and authorization as out-of-the-box features in Discord's internal developer platform.
Build out service identity provisioning using PKI and mTLS, so services can authenticate each other without shared secrets.
Evaluate or extend infrastructure access tooling such as Teleport for short-lived, auditable access to hosts, databases, and internal systems.
Improve how secrets are issued, rotated, and scoped across our infrastructure.
What we look for
5+ years of experience building and operating production systems or infrastructure
3+ years of experience writing software in a general-purpose programming language (we mainly use Python, TypeScript, and Rust)
3+ years of experience securing systems with millions of users
Experience building or operating identity and access management systems: authentication, authorization, or access control at scale
Understanding of modern authentication and authorization concepts (e.g. RBAC, OAuth, OIDC, SSO, Zero Trust network architectures, mTLS, cloud IAM)
Experience building in and securing multi-cloud environments (e.g. GCP, Cloudflare, AWS)
Experience designing and building software for customers (internal or external) beyond your immediate team
Bonus points if you have…
Experience defining and orchestrating containers (e.g. via Kubernetes, Docker, Distroless, OCI)
Familiarity with build and CI/CD technologies (e.g. Terraform, Bazel, Buildkite)
Provisioned or managed service and workload identity using PKI, including issuing and operating mTLS between services
Experience with Zero Trust platforms such as Cloudflare Access and Teleport, for auditable access to apps, hosts, and internal systems
Experience with secrets management systems (e.g. Vault, or a cloud KMS or secrets manager), including rotation and least-privilege access to secrets
Developed and debugged distributed systems atop GCP, Cloudflare, and/or AWS
Led complex migrations or risk management programs across an engineering organization
Built or operated a service mesh (e.g. Envoy, Istio)
Managed and secured VMs or bare-metal hosts (e.g. Linux, Salt)
Practices to discover industry tools and knowledge that can multiply your team's impact

Discord is looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Engineering team and partner with Consumer Revenue. Our mission is to make it easy for all users to discover, understand, buy, and keep Premium Products on Discord. In this role, you will set technical direction for the data systems that support Nitro, Shop, server monetization and gifting, and other consumer revenue experiences. You will build reliable data foundations that help teams understand performance, run experiments, and make better product and business decisions.
You’ll work closely with Data Science, Product, Finance, Data Platform, and engineering partners. If you’re excited to lead complex data engineering work, raise the quality of shared data products, and help a high-velocity consumer business grow, read on.
What You'll Be Doing
Set technical direction for Consumer Revenue data engineering: identify foundational gaps, define scalable architectures and standards, and lead high-impact initiatives from design through adoption.
Design and own canonical data models and datasets for consumer monetization, including subscriptions and subscriber states, purchases and payments, Shop, gifting, and Orbs. Make these assets reliable, well-documented, and useful across product analytics, financial reporting, experimentation, and decision-making.
Build and evolve production data pipelines that transform source events and transactional data into accurate, trusted data products. Balance freshness, reliability, cost, and maintainability across batch and, where the use case calls for it, lower-latency processing.
Partner with Data Science, Product, Finance, and engineering teams to define and operationalize important business metrics—including subscriber, revenue, booking, retention, and product usage measures—and ensure definitions are consistent across reporting and experimentation.
Strengthen the data foundations behind high-velocity product work and revenue growth. Translate ambiguous questions into robust models, metrics, and analytical capabilities that help teams size opportunities, evaluate launches, and learn from experiments.
Establish data quality, testing, monitoring, and documentation practices for the data assets you own. Pay particular attention to accuracy, freshness, auditability, and edge cases in subscription, payment, and commerce data.
Improve self-service analytics by maintaining a discoverable semantic layer, reusable data models, and clear guidance that let partner teams answer common questions with less bespoke support. Contribute to AI-assisted analytics workflows where they can make data access more useful and dependable.
Work closely with upstream Data Platform and downstream Data Science partners to align on interfaces, data contracts, and operational expectations; communicate trade-offs and risks clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor data engineers through design and code reviews, technical guidance, and ownership of complex projects. Raise the bar for engineering quality and help teams adopt consistent data modeling and documentation practices.
What You Should Have
7+ years of experience building and operating production data pipelines and data products, including significant hands-on ownership of architecture and implementation.
Expert-level SQL and strong Python skills, with experience writing maintainable, tested production code.
A track record of designing robust data models from large-scale event, product, or transactional data and making them usable for analytics, reporting, and experimentation.
Experience setting technical direction across complex projects, identifying systemic data problems, and delivering solutions that multiple teams can rely on.
Strong data quality instincts, including experience with testing, monitoring, data freshness, documentation, and the investigation of metric discrepancies.
Experience with modern data engineering tools and workflows (for example, dbt, BigQuery, Dagster, or equivalent), version control, and CI/CD practices.
Experience partnering with Data Science, Product, Finance, and Engineering to turn ambiguous business questions into clear metric definitions and dependable data products.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build alignment, explain technical trade-offs, and earn trust across teams.
A desire to work with thoughtful, passionate people who care deeply about solving challenging problems to improve Discord.
Bonus Points:
Passion for Discord or online communities
Experience with subscription, payments, e-commerce, virtual currency, or other consumer monetization data.
Experience building data products for experimentation, causal measurement, or product launch evaluation.
Experience developing a semantic layer, metrics store, or self-service analytics platform.
Experience with streaming or near-real-time data systems, or improving the reliability and observability of critical pipelines.
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or tools that help teams safely discover and use trusted data.
Passion for Discord, gaming, or online communities.

Discord's Experimentation Platform puts data at the heart of the company's decision-making and growth - we run hundreds of experiments at any given time, and those results turn directly into business decisions across Discord.
As a Staff Data Scientist on this team, you will ensure that the statistical underpinnings of our experiments are sound, that experimenters are able to design experiments with high rigor, and that Discord makes the best business decisions on the basis of these experiments. We are a small and quickly growing team; you will be presented with significant leadership opportunities as we evolve.
Our team directly impacts the strategy and roadmaps that improve Discord for its more than 90M daily active users! If helping make Discord an even better place to hang out with your friends sounds like an exciting challenge - we'd love to chat with you!
What you will be doing
Formulate the vision and set the roadmap for the future of the Experimentation Platform, in partnership with engineering, product, and data science stakeholders.
Provide statistical expertise, ensuring that experimentation methodologies and frameworks are sound and aligned with best practices in causal inference and experimental design.
Partner closely with engineering and product to improve the reliability, scalability, and adoption of experimentation across Discord - including modern AI/LLM tooling where it can accelerate rigor and speed.
Lead initiatives to educate and train cross-functional teams - including workshops, training sessions, and educational materials - on experimentation design, statistical methodology, and causal inference.

Proven experience leading experimentation platform work, including designing and validating statistical methodologies to ensure the accuracy and reliability of experimental results.
PhD in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Economics, Political Science, Psychology) or equivalent practical experience, plus 4+ years designing, implementing, and analyzing experiments or causal inference projects.
Ability to critically evaluate and recommend statistical approaches that balance velocity and reliability across a variety of product launches.
Strong passion for education, with a track record of communicating complex statistical and experimental design concepts to technical and non-technical audiences and fostering a culture of data literacy.

Track record using causal inference methods that translated into business decisions and outcomes.
Experience autonomously leading cross-functional projects and influencing cross-functional partners.

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.
Discord's Enterprise Technology org is building a software engineering discipline from the ground up, and this is the founding engineering hire. There is no Enterprise Platform team yet. You will not be maintaining a status quo or joining an existing backlog: you will define the discipline, set the technical foundation, and build the platform that lets the internal systems enabling Discordians scale with the company.
Discord's mission is to cultivate belonging, and doing that at scale requires internal systems that move as fast as the product itself. The mission of this role is to turn our enterprise infrastructure into self-service software. Your job is to replace manual consoles and tickets with a platform of reusable primitives, building blocks like "provision a device" or "push an IAM policy or app integration through code," exposed through clean APIs and self-service portals. As a code-forward Staff engineer, you will design abstractions that hide the messy reality of Okta, Jamf, and Terraform (our identity, device management, and infrastructure-as-code tools) behind interfaces people actually want to use, operating with a platform-as-a-product mindset.
What You'll Do
Manage the device fleet as code: Move device configuration off consoles and into versioned, API-driven infrastructure for endpoint management and hardware provisioning.
Automate the identity layer: Manage identity systems and their connections to downstream apps as code, from SSO and SCIM integrations to account workflows, so changes ship through version control and CI/CD instead of an admin console.
Own app delivery and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC): Build deployment pipelines and provisioning patterns that let internal systems be built and changed safely, establishing CI/CD standards.
Build the self-service layer: Design and ship the APIs, CLIs, and portals that compose primitives into paved paths, like a new hire's first day, where software access and group memberships land in one automated, auditable flow.
Set the foundation: Define the technical direction and architecture for the discipline, writing the RFCs and documentation that future hires will build on.
What You Should Have
6+ years building and operating production software and systems at a technology company, with a track record of owning ambiguous projects end to end.
Strong software engineering fundamentals. You write production code (we lean on Python, TypeScript and Rust), and design, test, and ship it. This is not a systems admin role.
Deep, hands-on IAM experience (SSO, SCIM, OAuth/OIDC, RBAC) and fluency with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and CI/CD.
Experience treating endpoint and fleet management as an API-driven engineering surface at scale.
A platform-as-a-product mindset. You have built self-service tooling that people chose to adopt.
Comfort with ambiguity and a founder's temperament; energized by building from scratch.
Bonus Points
Hands-on experience with Okta, Jamf, or Intune.
Experience with identity and access governance for non-human, workload, or AI-agent principals.
Background at a high-growth consumer tech company with a highly technical employee base.

Technical Program Managers operate within the Security and IT organization and have technical knowledge that enables them to manage company-wide programs, guide cross-team projects, and accelerate the execution of a team's roadmap. Security and IT are the teams responsible for protecting Discord's users, employees, and infrastructure - spanning security engineering, detection & response, corporate IT, and the governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) programs that keep Discord audit-ready and regulator-facing.
This is a Staff TPM role, reporting to the Director of TPM, responsible for developing and driving security, IT, and compliance programs across a fast-moving, high-scrutiny environment. If you are a productive, first-principles thinker who develops strong relationships between partners, we'd encourage you to apply!
What you'll do
Work closely with Security Engineering, IT, Legal, Privacy, and other cross-functional engineering teams to implement solutions supporting detection & response, identity & access management, and endpoint/device management
Manage multiple complex programs, often with competing timelines and resource needs across security, IT, and compliance stakeholders
Develop a holistic and enduring ownership model for our code, products, and programs
Leverage your strong compliance-centric mindset to help build and run our Security and IT programs.
Partner with Security, IT and GRC leadership to identify, develop, and run programs that mature our control environment (familiar with SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST) while keeping pace with product velocity
Drive programs such as BYOD/MDM, identity & access (joiner/mover/leaver, privileged access, access reviews), and third-party/vendor risk management toward measurable, audit-ready outcomes
Partner with Security leadership to identify, develop, and run programs that improve the security of our users and company
Manage multiple complex projects, often with competing timelines and resource needs
Streamline our Security Incident Management processes, including severity classification and escalation
What you have
8+ years of Technical Program/Product Management experience working with fast-paced Security, IT, or Infrastructure engineering teams
Experienced with core Security programs (e.g., Vulnerability Management, Application Security Reviews, Security Incident Response) at a similarly-sized company
Experience working on programs related to security compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST, PCI-DSS) at a similarly-sized company
Worked with Engineering, Trust and Safety, Legal, and Privacy leadership to implement compliance requirements or meet regulatory needs, especially related to data protection or information security
Experience moving technical or engineering programs from concept to completion and promoting the impact using metrics, risk reduction, and audit-readiness outcomes
Can break down complex challenges into workable components and make continuous progress towards solving a problem vs. trying to boil the ocean
Comfortable operating in rooms with executive leadership, including presenting risk posture and program status to C-suite audiences.
Bonus points
A love for helping & empowering others
BA/BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant technical experience
Security or compliance certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CIPP, CISA)
Familiarity with security tooling ecosystems (SIEM, EDR, IAM platforms)
Experience programmatically supporting a detection & response or SOC function (24x7 coverage models, threat intel, incident postmortems)
Exposure to public-company readiness work - SOX/ICFR, segregation of duties, access reviews - or Internal Audit partnership
Strong customer-empathy that ensures your preferred solutions take into account both user trust/Safety and company needs
